snippet.title: Arcane Eats Developer Spotlight at 2025 Dames4Games Ghouls 4 Games ~ Demo Coming Nov. 4th!
snippet.description:
Break out the Gastronomicon, Arcane Eats DEMO is coming November 4th!
Wishlist NOW and be first to sink your teeth into the world’s most delicious fantasy roguelike deckbuilder!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2640090?utm_source=Youtube&utm_campaign=D4G2025

Andrea of Wonderbelly Games, the studio behind Arcane Eats, joins the 2025 Dames4Games Ghouls 4 Games Halloween Bash to share a peek at the upcoming fantasy cooking roguelike deckbuilder AND reveal that the demo arrives November 4th - wishlist now!
